idea-plugin.name: pyproject.toml Release Gate (PEP 639)
idea-plugin.description:
19 date-aware checks on the [project] metadata that decides whether your next release uploads

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → pyproject.toml Release Gate (PEP 639): Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pyproject-release-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pyproject-release-gate
